data.name: Turbowheels
data.detailed_description:
Turbowheels is an explosive party game where fast cars collide with absolute madness and friendships are challenged like never before. Forget boring racing circuits and traffic rules—this is all about surviving and outsmarting your opponents.

Gather your friends, grab the controllers, and dive into the arena in ruthless local multiplayer. Whether it's precision dodging or lightning-fast reactions in absurd situations, every game mode will put your driving skills and nerves of steel to the test.
------------------------------------------------------
Key Features:

  • Local Multiplayer: Designed from the ground up for couch gaming. Dirty tricks, sneaky rams and evil laughs right in your living room are guaranteed.

  • Crazy & Diverse game modes: Test your reflexes in a heart-pounding dash through an explosive minefield, embark on a bizarre animal hunt right from behind the wheel and discover plenty of other classics or original game modes.

  • Full Controller Support: Turbowheels is fully optimized for gamepads. Just plug in your controller, jump into the game, and hit the gas without any complicated setup.

  • Easy to Learn, Hard to Master: Intuitive controls mean absolutely anyone can pick up and play. However, becoming the true king of the arena and mastering the four-wheeled chaos will require practice and finding the right strategy.

------------------------------------------------------

Demolition Derby

Destroy your opponents using items that you can buy after each round. Or knock them into lava. Earn money by destroying others or by being the last one standing.

Drive to survive

Your goal is survive longer than other racers. If you are too far behind the leading racer on the circuit, you explode. The winner of the round gets 2 points, the runner-up gets 1 point, and the last one loses a point. The first one to reach 8 points wins.

Chaos challenge

Participate in a chaotic tournament. In each round, you will face a different challenge and receive points for your performance. Collect the most points, and the victory is yours!

Normal race

Just a classic race. Choose any number of laps, a track, and a vehicle. The first one to finish is a winner!

------------------------------------------------------

Spin your wheels, rev your engines, and prove to everyone who the real champion of Turbowheels is!

data.short_description: Turbowheels is a dynamic car party game where you compete against your friends in a series of crazy game modes. Get behind the wheel, step on the gas, and prove your skills in a variety of challenges, ranging from frantic racing to total demolition chaos.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750-Ti / AMD RX 550, 2GB VRam
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Soundcard
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 7500K / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580, 4GB VRam / Intel Arc A380
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Soundcard
